title: Integrated Facilities Management Agreement (Terms in Annex)
description: Facilities maintenance agreement where key commercial payment and commitment terms are located in Annex Schedule A.

payment_terms.quote: All maintenance fees are subject to payment terms of Net 45 calendar days after invoice approval.

price_adjustment.quote: Facility hourly labor rates are firm and fixed for the entire 3-year term.

contract_term.quote: The initial term of this Agreement shall be 36 months from execution date.

auto_renewal.quote: The contract will automatically renew for successive 12-month periods.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate with written notice of at least 60 days.

liability_cap.quote: Total liability under this agreement shall not exceed $750,000 USD.

governing_law.quote: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.

volume_commitment.quote: Owner commits to a minimum spend of $350,000 USD per contract year for corporate campus maintenance.
